name: loop-breaker
description: Notices when Claude is going in circles (the same command failing again and again, the same code rewritten over and over) and tells Claude to step back and rethink, and tells you too.

failLimit.title: Same failing command limit
failLimit.description: Nudge after the same shell command fails this many times in a row.

editLimit.title: Reworks of the same code per turn
editLimit.description: Nudge after Claude rewrites code it already changed this turn this many times (separate edits to different parts of a file never count).
